card.fires_on: The percent sign, mL, or the article "a" right after a concentration or volume, where the next word is likely "solution". Seen in dilution and preparation instructions.

modes.label: Concentration units
modes.description: A percent sign or per-mL unit after a number, just before "solution" or "suspension".

modes.label: Article before a solution
modes.description: The word "a" after a volume or a verb like add or spray, before a named solution.
